checks.lead: Félix Rubén García Sarmiento (18 January 1867 – 6 February 1916), known as Rubén Darío (US:  dah-REE-oh, Spanish: [ruˈβen daˈɾi.o]), was a Nicaraguan poet who initiated the Spanish-language literary movement known as modernismo (modernism) that flourished at the end of the 19th century. Darío had a great and lasting influence on 20th-century Spanish-language literature and journalism.
